meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发前的调研与访谈整理成可直接执行的编码方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到编程任务时希望先彻底理清需求再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn pre-coding research into an executable development plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, approved plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 激活后Claude变成规划顾问Prometheus：先只读探索代码库，必要时提问，等你明确批准才写出决策完整的工作计划（放在.omo/下），绝不直接改动代码，实现需另开会话执行。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用ulw-plan工作流时触发，比如说出“ulw-plan”、“plan this”等关键词，或用自己话要求在编码前制定计划。技能从不自行激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给这个功能做个开发计划。
say.note: 会进入规划模式，先探索代码再等你确认。

say.text: 进入 plan mode，先别写代码，先出方案。
say.note: 触发规划流程，并等待你的明确批准。

say.text: 把“优化登录”拆成 ulw-plan 工作计划。
say.note: 意图模糊时自动研究并给出默认方案。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude acts as Prometheus, a planning consultant: it explores the codebase read-only, asks only necessary questions, and after your explicit approval writes one decision-complete work plan under .omo/. It never implements; execution happens in a separate worker session.
howto.when_en: Activates only when the user explicitly requests the ulw-plan workflow, e.g., saying "ulw-plan", "plan this", or asking for a work plan before coding in their own words. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to make a dev plan for this feature.
say_en.note: Enters planning mode, explores first, then waits for your approval.

say_en.text: Plan mode: don't code yet, just outline the approach.
say_en.note: Triggers planning and waits for your explicit okay.

say_en.text: Break down 'improve login' into a ulw-plan work plan.
say_en.note: Fuzzy intent leads to research and best-practice defaults.
